content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The primary issue with conventional payment systems is their geographic limitations. In Kenya, platforms like Stripe have not established a presence, leaving creators without viable payment options. COREMERCH's solution eliminates these barriers by utilizing decentralized technologies. By employing blockchain-based payments, you gain access to a global market without relying on traditional banks or payment processors. This infrastructure empowers you to transact directly with customers anywhere in the world while ensuring you retain full control over your data and assets.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, gather your digital assets, which can include ebooks, courses, or any downloadable products. You'll need a domain name to host your store and access to a cloud hosting service like Cloudflare Pages. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency payment processing. Additionally, setting up a wallet to receive USDT on the Tron network is crucial, as this will facilitate fast and cost-effective transactions.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment processor through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Create a webhook to receive real-time payment notifications. Then, set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, ensuring your digital products are automatically sent to customers upon payment confirmation. Utilize Google Sheets or Supabase to manage orders and customer data, keeping everything organized and easily accessible. This streamlined approach allows for efficient handling of transactions and delivery.
Own your digital commerce infrastructure completely and avoid platform lock-in.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is ready, it's time to launch your store. Test the entire process by making a small purchase yourself. Ensure that the payment is processed successfully and that your product is delivered promptly. This trial run will help identify any potential issues before you start promoting your store. Once everything is confirmed working, share your store on social media and other platforms to reach a wider audience, enabling you to maximize sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Leverage analytics to understand customer behavior and optimize your offerings. Consider expanding your product line or offering bundles to attract more buyers. Engage with your audience through email marketing and social media to build a loyal customer base. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides additional resources, including blueprints and templates to enhance your infrastructure and support your growth.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products internationally by using decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments. This platform processes cryptocurrency transactions without geographical restrictions, enabling seamless access to global markets. By leveraging blockchain technology, you can sell ebooks and other digital products without relying on traditional payment processors that may not support African currencies.
Leverage blockchain for fast, cost-effective payment processing anywhere in the world.

Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
